# Native Tline reports

The log excerpts keep the station text and CRLF line endings.
The scan and enforcement excerpts come from the 320 kV armoured option study,
run `20261018-230729`.

- `scan_violations.log`: impulse variant 1. Curve fit and scan.
- `enforcement_failed.log`: impulse variant 31. Full enforcement section.
- `enforcement_success.log`: impulse variant 61. Full enforcement section.

`dc_correction.log` comes from the 320 kV armoured DC behaviour study,
run `20261018-170642`, variant 10. It contains the curve fit, DC correction and scan.

The original failure log and build messages record the INVCJD singularity.

`fd_mode.log` comes from the 320 kV armoured option study,
run `20261018-230729`, impulse variant 47. It contains the modal fitting rows.
